candidates.description: This feature vector represents abstract mental constructs, thoughts, and theoretical concepts.
This vector activates for words, terms, and translations related to negation, denial, and the absence of something.
This vector represents first-person plural pronouns and related grammatical inflections across multiple languages.
This feature activates on terms and word fragments related to contradiction, clarification, and interpretation.
These tokens represent modal verbs expressing ability, possibility, or permission across multiple languages.
This vector represents communication verbs expressing cognitive acts, claims, or relationships.
This vector represents the domain of philosophy, literature, and intellectual figures.
This vector represents common German verb lemmas and their inflected forms.
This feature vector represents likelihood, possibility, and feasibility across multiple languages.
This vector represents German auxiliary, modal, and copular verbs in various tense and number forms.
